name: Gyre Archivist
text:
{2}{U}, {T}: Return target instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Gyre Archivist from your graveyard to your hand. Then put a charge counter on Gyre Archivist. Activate only during your upkeep.
{1}, Exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard: Remove a charge counter from Gyre Archivist. Activate only as a sorcery.
